title: Sargon of Akkad begins his reign over Akkad
summary: CFAH-15 (OSF preprint) AP-92: Sargon of Akkad defeated Ur-Zababa and began his reign over Akkad, 1619 BC.
description: CFAH-15 (OSF preprint) AP-92: Sargon of Akkad defeated Ur-Zababa and began his reign over Akkad, 1619 BC.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 1619 BC (AP-92, OSF preprint CFAH-15)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file "CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf", p. 21
chronologies.note: CFAH-15 p. 21: "The defeat of Ur Zababa by Sargon of Akkad, starting his reign over Akkad to the year 1619 BC, Anchor Point #92." OSF preprint, not peer-reviewed in ARJ; see docs/OPEN-QUESTIONS-FOR-KEVIN.md on whether preprint anchor points should set tier 1. Conventional dates put Sargon c. 2334–2279 BC; CFAH's date is about 700 years later.
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020), ch. 4 "First Empires in Mesopotamia (2360–1750 BC)", PDF p. 82 (printed p. 81)
chronologies.note: Sargon overthrows Urukagina; p. 83: "ruled from 2334 BC to 2279 BC". The Timeline Review (p. 114) prints "Sargon I Rules 2100/2164* bc", which does not match the text. Differs from the sort year (1619 BC, cfah-anchor) by 715 years.
chronologies.edition_note: 1st ed. (2020); superseded by the 2nd ed. (2024), which prints "1638–1477 BC" (PDF p. 239): 696 years later.

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 10 "The Beginning of Babylon–First of the Mesopotamian Empires", PDF p. 239 (printed p. 225)
